main_text.p: libi fusius meminimē disserere. Cur verò è Comicorum principe M. Accio Plauto talem Electorum Sylvam potius collegerim, quàm ex alio Latinitatis Romanæ Auctore, exposui in Præmonitione ad Lectorem, ipsis Electis præfixâ: ubi & instituti mei rationes, & Plauti, adeoq. universa Comoediæ dignitatem iterùm assertum ivi. Nunc si qui Aphorismi in Electis nostris nonnullis fortean visi sint obscuriores, aut cæteroquin suspecti, conabor illos σὺν τοῖς μύθοις breviorибus istis Notis nostris paulò succinctius explicare, illustrare, ac, sicubi res feret, confirmare, ac defendere. Tu Lector benevole, εὐφήμει! & his nostris laboribus utere, fruere.

page.notes: The Greek in the text is printed with a few doubtful letters, the phrase "σὺν τοῖς μύθοις" and "breviorибus" marked by faint print; "breviorибus" is likely "brevioribus" with a Cyrillic-looking letter that should be Latin. Lower half of the page shows only show-through and is omitted.
